body: Founder first playtest: towers basically invincible, and KOing tanks. Two bugs: (1) co-located node-guardian creep starved the tower of all damage via a shared attack-cooldown slot -- fixed by not letting the creep spawn while the tower stands. (2) MAX_HP 1600 / DAMAGE 40 were never weighed against hero base HP (100) -- rescaled to 420/14. Full suite green, build clean.
title: Fix: towers were unkillable + one-shotting heroes
